components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #4a2512; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4a2512; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-icon { pointer-events: none; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.description: Default text input. Transparent with tan border stroke.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #1a0f0a; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e2d8cc; border-radius: 0.7rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b7a67; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4a2512; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(74,37,18,0.25); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; background: rgba(226,216,204,0.5); }

narrative.overview:
This system is the counter where orders happen — welcoming, tactile, unpretentious. The visual identity evokes an independent craft coffee shop: warm earth tones, honest materials, confident simplicity. Every pixel serves the barista or manager under real time pressure; there is nothing decorative for its own sake.

The design is warm without being cute, grounded without being heavy, efficient without being cold. Surfaces use soft tonal layering rather than shadows for depth. Interactive elements feel tactile and confident — solid backgrounds, clear hover states, responsive press effects. The single-typeface approach (Bricolage Grotesque for everything) keeps noise low and legibility high. DM Mono is reserved for prices and tabular data, where exact alignment matters.
keyCharacteristics: Warm earth-tone palette: cream backgrounds, rich brown primaries, amber accents
Single sans-serif typeface (Bricolage Grotesque) with mono for tabular numbers
Tonal layering instead of drop shadows for surface hierarchy
Gem-like border radii (8px default, scaling from 5px to 21px)
Grain texture overlay for tactile depth without decoration
Touch-first POS with large targets; mouse-friendly admin in the same system

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber (#c07830) is the only accent. It never competes with a second accent color.

rules.name: The Cream Canvas Rule
rules.body: The page background (#f4efe8) is the warm anchor. Cards sit white on top; the contrast creates depth without shadows.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Any displayed price, quantity, order ID, or code uses DM Mono with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces have no resting shadows. Hierarchy comes from background color (cream canvas / white card / dark modal backdrop).

dos: Use semantic tokens only — no raw color classes.
Keep body text at 4.5:1 minimum contrast against its background.
Use DM Mono with `tabular-nums` for all prices, quantities, and order IDs.
Use the grain overlay (`grain-overlay` class) on full-page backgrounds for tactile depth.
Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` — animations degrade gracefully to instant transitions.
Set large touch targets (minimum 44px) on all POS interactive elements.
Keep the accent (amber) to <10% of any given screen.
Use Bricolage Grotesque for all UI copy. No second sans-serif face.
donts: Don't use decorative shadows. Hierarchy comes from background color layering, not box-shadow.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradient text, or heavy blur effects.
Don't use a dark theme as default. The default is light (warm cream).
Don't introduce a second accent color. Amber is the single point of emphasis.
Don't use bright primary colors (reds, yellows, blues).
Don't use the fast-food aesthetic: no glossy surfaces, no neon, no aggressive gradients.
Don't style placeholder text as muted gray. Use #8b7a67 (4.5:1 contrast) or darker.
Don't place shadows on cards at rest.
